name: CHANDLER
full_name: Carbon Hydrogen AntiNeutrino Detector with a Lithium Enhanced Raghavan optical lattice
summary: CHANDLER develops a mobile segmented scintillator reactor-antineutrino detector. Its MiniCHANDLER demonstrator observed reactor neutrinos at North Anna, motivating an enlarged system for monitoring and compact detector studies.
detection_principle: Plastic scintillator cubes detect the positron from inverse beta decay, while lithium-6-loaded zinc-sulfide sheets capture the neutron. Total internal reflection channels light along the optical lattice and spatial topology separates signal from cosmic backgrounds.
